channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-31431 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Linux Kernel contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2026-34486 — Apache Tomcat
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Apache Tomcat contains a missing encryption of sensitive data vulnerability that allows the bypass of the EncryptInterceptor. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE‑2025‑24813.

item.title: CVE-2026-34197 — Apache ActiveMQ
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Apache ActiveMQ contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for code injection.

item.title: CVE-2026-3055 — Citrix NetScaler
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC), NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) and NetScaler ADC FIPS and NDcPP contain an out-of-bounds reads vulnerability when configured as a SAML IDP leading to memory overread.

item.title: CVE-2026-42208 — BerriAI LiteLLM
item.description: Threat Signal 79. BerriAI LiteLLM contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to read data from the proxy's database and potentially modify it, leading to unauthorized access to the proxy and the credentials it manages.

item.title: CVE-2026-9082 — Drupal Core
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Drupal Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation and remote code execution via specially crafted requests sent with the database abstraction API.

item.title: CVE-2026-34908 — Ubiquiti UniFi OS
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to make unauthorized changes to the system.

item.title: CVE-2026-33017 — Langflow Langflow
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Langflow contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow building public flows without requiring authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-42897 — Microsoft Microsoft
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Exchange Server contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability during web page generation in Outlook Web Access and when certain interaction conditions are met, arbitrary JavaScript can be executed in the browser context.

item.title: CVE-2026-88772 — Citrix NetScaler
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

item.title: CVE-2026-88771 — Citrix NetScaler
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-105133 — Ahsay AhsayCBS
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

item.title: CVE-2026-33824 — Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions contains a double free vulnerability that could enable remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-21589 — Atlassian Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

item.title: CVE-2026-48558 — SimpleHelp SimpleHelp
item.description: Threat Signal 77. SimpleHelp contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the OIDC authentication flow. When OIDC authentication is configured, identity tokens submitted during login are accepted without verifying their cryptographic signature. In a vulnerable configuration, a remote, unauthenticated attacker can submit a forged token containing arbitrary identity claims to obtain a fully authenticated technician session. In some configurations, this may also allow bypass of multi-factor authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-48907 — Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow for upload and execution of PHP code via the creation of new editor profiles for unauthenticated users.

item.title: CVE-2026-34909 — Ubiquiti UniFi OS
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to access files on the underlying system that could be manipulated to access an underlying account.

item.title: CVE-2026-45498 — Microsoft Defender
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft Defender contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-48710 — Kludex Starlette
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.

item.title: CVE-2026-45659 — Microsoft SharePoint Server
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Microsoft SharePoint Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-104935 — Ivanti Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-32202 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft Windows Shell contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-39987 — Marimo Marimo
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Marimo contains an pre-authorization remote code execution vulnerability, allowing an unauthenticated attacked to shell access and execute arbitrary system commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-87902 — WordPress Core
item.description: Threat Signal 82. WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-33634 — Aquasecurity Trivy
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Aquasecurity Trivy contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain access to everything in the CI/CD environment, including all tokens, SSH keys, cloud credentials, database passwords, and any sensitive configuration in memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-39808 — Fortinet FortiSandbox
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Fortinet FortiSandbox contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted HTTP requests.

item.title: CVE-2026-34910 — Ubiquiti UniFi OS
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper input validation vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to conduct command injection.

item.title: CVE-2026-105134 — Ahsay AhsayCBS
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

item.title: CVE-2026-76504 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

item.title: CVE-2026-6973 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remotely authenticated user with administrative access to achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-21510 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Windows Shell contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

item.title: CVE-2025-14174 — Google Chromium
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Google Chromium contains an out of bounds memory access vulnerability in ANGLE that could allow a remote attacker to perform out of bounds memory access via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2025-43300 — Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Image I/O framework.

item.title: CVE-2014-9163 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Stack-based buffer overflow in Adobe Flash Player allows attackers to execute code remotely.

item.title: CVE-2026-45247 — Mirasvit Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by supplying a crafted serialized PHP object in the CacheWarmer cookie.

item.title: CVE-2026-94127 — F5 BIG-IP APM
item.description: Threat Signal 68. F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-86950 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-8037 — Progress LoadMaster
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Progress LoadMaster contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an un-authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the LoadMaster appliance by exploiting unsanitized input in multiple command endpoints.

item.title: CVE-2026-34926 — Trend Micro Apex One
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Trend Micro Apex One (on-premise) contains a directory traversal vulnerability that could allow a pre-authenticated local attacker to modify a key table on the server to inject malicious code to deploy to agents on affected installations.

item.title: CVE-2026-48172 — LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin
item.description: Threat Signal 66. LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin contains privilege escalation vulnerability that is exposed via the user-end cPanel plugin, which can be abused by any cPanel user account to execute arbitrary scripts with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2024-12686 — BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS)
item.description: Threat Signal 60. BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) contain an OS command injection vulnerability that can be exploited by an attacker with existing administrative privileges to upload a malicious file. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can allow a remote attacker to execute underlying operating system commands within the context of the site user.

item.title: CVE-2026-102764 — BeyondTrust Remote Support
item.description: Threat Signal 70. BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

item.title: CVE-2026-93616 — Check Point Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

item.title: CVE-2026-5281 — Google Dawn
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Google Dawn contains an use-after-free vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker who had compromised the renderer process to execute arbitrary code via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple Chromium-based products including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2020-7796 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability if WebEx zimlet installed and zimlet JSP is enabled.

item.title: CVE-2025-43529 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain a use-after-free vulnerability in WebKit. Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to memory corruption. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2026-41091 — Microsoft Defender
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Defender contains a link following vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2026-76460 — Cisco Identity Services Engine
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

item.title: CVE-2023-48365 — Qlik Sense
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Qlik Sense contains an HTTP tunneling vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges and execute HTTP requests on the backend server hosting the software.

item.title: CVE-2019-9875 — Sitecore CMS and Experience Platform (XP)
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Sitecore CMS and Experience Platform (XP) contain a deserialization vulnerability in the Sitecore.Security.AntiCSRF module that allows an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code by sending a serialized .NET object in the HTTP POST parameter __CSRFTOKEN.
